Ce poison nerveux provoque une paralysie chez toute victime qui échoue à son Jet de Résistance. Sûm-Kutia is a toxic preparation associated with the traditions of the Honnin of southwestern Endor. Its composition and place of manufacture are not described in the surviving data; assigning it a particular botanical habitat would therefore be unjustified.

This nerve poison causes paralysis in any victim who fails the Resistance Roll. The duration is calculated at approximately two rounds for every point of failure: a failure by five points results in roughly ten rounds of paralysis. This direct relationship between the failure margin and duration is Sûm-Kutia's defining property in play.
